  - For branch landing pages (cabang) and the public landing page section, the system provides a specialized CMS for individual branches and a global landing page management interface.

### 1. Branch Landing Pages (Cabang)

#### Routes (`routes/web.php`)
- **Public:** `Route::get('/cabang/{branch}', [BranchLandingController::class, 'show'])->name('cabang.show');`
- **Admin Management:**
  - `Route::get('/admin/landing/cabang', [BranchLandingContentController::class, 'index'])->name('landing.cabang.index');`
  - `Route::get('/admin/landing/cabang/{branch}', [BranchLandingContentController::class, 'show'])->name('landing.cabang.show');`
  - `Route::put('/admin/landing/cabang/{branch}', [BranchLandingContentController::class, 'update'])->name('landing.cabang.update');`

#### Controllers
- **Public:** `app/Http/Controllers/Public/BranchLandingController.php`
  - Handles the public-facing view for a specific branch. It fetches branch-specific teachers, packages, and custom settings (Hero, FAQ, features, programs).
- **Admin:** `app/Http/Controllers/Admin/BranchLandingContentController.php`
  - Provides the interface for admins to customize content for each branch, including image uploads (Hero BG, method images) and JSON-based lists (FAQ, subjects, features).

#### Views
- **Public:** `resources/views/branch-landing.blade.php`
  - The main template for individual branch landing pages.
- **Admin:**
  - `resources/views/admin/landing/cabang-index.blade.php`: List of branches to manage.
  - `resources/views/admin/landing/cabang.blade.php`: The editor for branch-specific content.

#### Models
- `app/Models/Branch.php`: Represents the branch entity.
- `app/Models/BranchLandingSetting.php`: Stores custom configuration for each branch using a key-value pair system. It includes helper methods like `getJson`, `setVal`, and `forBranch`.

---

### 2. Public Landing Page (Global)

#### Routes (`routes/web.php`)
- **Public Home:** `Route::get('/', function() { ... })->name('landing');` (Returns `resources/views/landing.blade.php`).
- **Admin Management:** `Route::prefix('admin/landing')->name('admin.landing.')->group(...)` covers settings, testimonials, programs, WA numbers, tickers, features, jenjangs, etc.

#### Controllers
- **Admin:** `app/Http/Controllers/Admin/LandingContentController.php`
  - A comprehensive controller managing multiple landing page sections (Testimonials, Programs, FAQ, Galery, etc.).

#### Views
- **Public:** `resources/views/landing.blade.php`
  - The global landing page.
- **Admin:** `resources/views/admin/landing/index.blade.php`
  - A tabbed or multi-section editor for global landing page content.

#### Models
The global landing page is backed by several models:
- `LandingSetting`, `LandingFaq`, `LandingFeature`, `LandingGallery`, `LandingHighlight`, `LandingJenjang`, `LandingProgram`, `LandingTestimonial`, `LandingTicker`, `LandingTrust`, `LandingWaNumber`.

### Summary of Branch-Specific Content
The branch landing pages allow customization of:
- **Hero Section:** Badge, description, and background image.
- **Service Methods:** Pricing and images for Home Visit, Online, and Offline.
- **Dynamic Lists:** Areas covered, promo tickers, FAQ items, feature cards ("Dipercaya Ribuan Keluarga"), and subject cards ("Program Les & Kursus").

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Admin;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;

class BranchLandingContentController extends Controller
{
    public function index()
    {
        $branches = Branch::orderBy('name')->get();
        return view('admin.landing.cabang-index', compact('branches'));
    }

    /* ── Branch CRUD ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */

    public function storeBranch(Request $request)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'name'   => 'required|string|max:255',
            'city'   => 'nullable|string|max:255',
            'address'=> 'nullable|string',
            'phone'  => 'nullable|string|max:50',
            'email'  => 'nullable|email|max:255',
            'status' => 'nullable|in:aktif,nonaktif',
            'photo'  => 'nullable|image|max:4096',
        ]);

        $data = $request->only(['name','city','address','phone','email']);
        $data['status'] = $request->input('status', 'aktif');

        if ($request->hasFile('photo') && $request->file('photo')->isValid()) {
            $path = $request->file('photo')->store('landing/cabang/photos', 'public');
            $data['photo'] = Storage::url($path);
        }

        Branch::create($data);

        return back()->with('success', 'Cabang berhasil ditambahkan.');
    }

    public function updateBranch(Request $request, Branch $branch)
    {
        $request->validate([

    public function destroyBranch(Branch $branch)
    {
        $name = $branch->name;
        $branch->delete();
        return back()->with('success', 'Cabang ' . $name . ' berhasil dihapus.');
    }

    /* ── Branch Landing Content ──────────────────────────────────── */

    public function show(Branch $branch)
    {
        $s = BranchLandingSetting::forBranch($branch->id);
        return view('admin.landing.cabang', compact('branch', 's'));
    }

    private function uploadImage(Request $request, string $field, int $bid): void
    {
        if ($request->hasFile($field) && $request->file($field)->isValid()) {
            $path = $request->file($field)->store("landing/cabang/{$bid}", 'public');
            BranchLandingSetting::setVal($bid, $field, Storage::url($path));
        }
    }

    public function update(Request $request, Branch $branch)
    {
        $bid = $branch->id;

        /* ── Image uploads (from laptop) ── */
        foreach (['hero_bg', 'metode_img_homevisi', 'metode_img_online', 'metode_img_offline'] as $field) {
            $this->uploadImage($request, $field, $bid);
        }

        /* ── Simple text keys ── */
        foreach ([
            'hero_badge', 'hero_description',
            'hours_weekday', 'hours_weekend',
            'price_homevisi', 'price_online', 'price_offline',
            'cta_eyebrow', 'cta_title', 'cta_desc',
        ] as $key) {
            BranchLandingSetting::setVal($bid, $key, $request->input($key, ''));
        }

        /* ── Areas (comma-separated → JSON) ── */
        $areas = array_values(array_filter(array_map('trim', explode(',', $request->input('areas', '')))));
        BranchLandingSetting::setVal($bid, 'areas', json_encode($areas));

        /* ── Promo items ── */
        $promo = array_values(array_filter(array_map('trim', $request->input('promo_items', []))));
        BranchLandingSetting::setVal($bid, 'promo_items', json_encode($promo));

        /* ── FAQ ── */
        $qs   = $request->input('faq_q', []);
        $as   = $request->input('faq_a', []);
        $faqs = [];
        foreach ($qs as $i => $q) {
            $q = trim($q); $a = trim($as[$i] ?? '');
            if ($q && $a) $faqs[] = ['q' => $q, 'a' => $a];
        }
        BranchLandingSetting::setVal($bid, 'faq_items', json_encode($faqs));

        /* ── Feature cards — Dipercaya Ribuan Keluarga ── */
        $features = [];
        foreach (($request->input('feat_title', [])) as $i => $title) {
            $title = trim($title);
            if ($title) {
                $features[] = [
                    'num'   => trim($request->input('feat_num')[$i] ?? sprintf('%02d', $i + 1)),
                    'icon'  => trim($request->input('feat_icon')[$i] ?? '⭐'),
                    'title' => $title,
                    'desc'  => trim($request->input('feat_desc')[$i] ?? ''),
                ];
            }
        }
        BranchLandingSetting::setVal($bid, 'features', json_encode($features));

        /* ── Subject cards — Program Les & Kursus ── */
        $subjects = [];
        foreach (($request->input('subj_name', [])) as $i => $name) {
            $name = trim($name);
            if ($name) {
                $subjects[] = [
                    'icon'       => trim($request->input('subj_icon')[$i] ?? '📚'),
                    'name'       => $name,
                    'desc'       => trim($request->input('subj_desc')[$i] ?? ''),
                    'badge'      => trim($request->input('subj_badge')[$i] ?? ''),
                    'badge_type' => trim($request->input('subj_badge_type')[$i] ?? 'general'),
                ];
            }
        }
        BranchLandingSetting::setVal($bid, 'subjects', json_encode($subjects));

        return back()->with('success', 'Konten landing page cabang '.$branch->name.' berhasil disimpan.');
